data.name: Ryun
data.gender_notes: Ryun is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ryun is a name of Old English origin, derived from the words 'rye' meaning 'king' and 'un' meaning 'little' or 'one'. It is a name of great courage and nobility, evoking images of a brave and valiant ruler. The name is often associated with the Celtic god Rui, a god of the sun and strength. The name Ryun carries the meaning “Brave, little king” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Ryun usually hope their child will grow to embody brave, little king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
